result.instructions: Tools for Bind ERP, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which invoices are overdue and how much is still unpaid per client?"; "Which products in my main warehouse have fewer than 5 units left?"; "Show last month's sales orders for the client Acme.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Bind ERP data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run binderp_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run binderp_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run binderp_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. binderp_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: binderp_get_account
tools.title: Get account
tools.description: The Bind ERP user and company this API key belongs to: user name, email, roles, branches (locations), company name, RFC (tax id), legal/commercial name, fiscal type and address. GET /api/UserProfile and /api/CompanyProfile.

tools.name: binderp_list_catalog
tools.title: List catalog (branches, warehouses, price lists, currencies, bank accounts, users, categories)
tools.description: List one of the reference catalogs whose ids other tools need: locations (branches), warehouses, price_lists, currencies, bank_accounts (with balances), users (employees) or categories. GET /api/Locations, /api/Warehouses, /api/PriceLists, /api/Currencies, /api/BankAccounts, /api/Users, /api/Categories.

tools.name: binderp_create_prospect
tools.title: Create prospect
tools.description: Create a sales prospect (lead) in Bind ERP. Writes a new record visible to the whole team; it is not deduplicated, so check binderp_list_prospects first. No message is sent to the prospect. POST /api/Prospects.

is_public.description: Visible to all users (true) or only to the key's user (false).

tools.name: binderp_create_client
tools.title: Create client
tools.description: Create a customer in Bind ERP. Writes a new customer record (with credit terms) and is not deduplicated: check binderp_list_clients for the RFC first. The RFC must be valid for the tax authority (use XAXX010101000 for a generic public customer). No message is sent. Get price_list_id and location_id from binderp_list_catalog. POST /api/Clients.

price_list_id.description: Price list id (catalog price_lists) (a GUID, as returned by the list tools).

accounting_number.description: Accounting account number for the customer (required by the API).

tools.name: binderp_add_comment
tools.title: Add comment
tools.description: Add a comment to a Bind ERP record (client, prospect, order, ...) identified by its GUID. The comment becomes part of that record's history and cannot be removed through this API. POST /api/Comments.

external_id.description: Id of the record to comment on (client, prospect, order...) (a GUID, as returned by the list tools).

tools.name: binderp_create_order
tools.title: Create sales order
tools.description: Create a customer order (pedido, not an invoice: nothing is stamped or invoiced and no email is sent) with product and/or service lines. It reserves stock and shows up in the sales pipeline, so confirm client, prices and quantities first. Get ids from binderp_list_clients, binderp_get_client_addresses, binderp_list_catalog and binderp_list_products. POST /api/Orders.

client_id.description: Client id (a GUID, as returned by the list tools).

address_id.description: Delivery address id (binderp_get_client_addresses) (a GUID, as returned by the list tools).

currency_id.description: Currency id (catalog currencies) (a GUID, as returned by the list tools).

location_id.description: Branch id (catalog locations) (a GUID, as returned by the list tools).

warehouse_id.description: Warehouse id (catalog warehouses) (a GUID, as returned by the list tools).

price_list_id.description: Price list id (catalog price_lists) (a GUID, as returned by the list tools).

exchange_rate.description: Exchange rate when the currency is not the base currency.

id.description: Product id (a GUID, as returned by the list tools).
Service (sale concept) id (a GUID, as returned by the list tools).
